problem:
Find the fourth term of the sequence given by the recurrence relation

$$
{a}_{n}=3{a}_{n-1}+2{a}_{n-2},\,{a}_{1}=2,\,{a}_{2}=4,\,n\ge 3.
$$
worked_solution:
Starting with the initial terms ${a}_{1}=2,$ and ${a}_{2}=4,$ we compute the next terms using the recursive formula until we reach the fourth term.

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{1} & =2 \\ {a}_{2} & =4 \\ {a}_{3} & =3{a}_{2}+2{a}_{1}=3\cdot 4+2\cdot 2=12+4=16 \\ {a}_{4} & =3{a}_{3}+2{a}_{2}=3\cdot 16+2\cdot 4=48+8=56\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the fourth term is ${a}_{4}=56.$
